{{Quote|We got company. Two Imperial ships, heading this way. Looks like ''Lancer''-class frigates.''"<br />"''Uh-oh. Maybe we didn't get off Ukio as clean as I thought.|[[Aves]] and [[Samuel Tomas Gillespee]]|<ref name="Last" />}}
A '''skirmish''' was fought near [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]] between two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]] and the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] chiefs [[Talon Karrde]] and [[Samuel Tomas Gillespee]].
